title: Android always-on start intent is ignored
reproduction: REGRESSION ADDED, NOT RUN: VpnServiceCommandInstrumentedTest covers decoder inputs; VpnLifecycleInstrumentedTest.frameworkStartIntentEstablishesForegroundTunnelAndResumesAfterStop uses framework action/package with no COMMAND extra, VPN mode, prepared consent, adawayLiveVpnSmoke=true and no existing VPN/service. Main still owns Settings always-on and reboot verification.
expected: Legitimate platform always-on start establishes foreground VPN; explicit START/STOP retain semantics, invalid private commands do not become START, and null sticky recreation starts. Always-on remains supported, not opted out.
observed: BASELINE SOURCE-CONFIRMED: Framework intent was UNKNOWN. IMPLEMENTATION SOURCE-REVIEWED ONLY: onStartCommand now uses action-scoped absent-extra fallback and existing startVpn lifecycle; no build, device reproduction or runtime pass claimed.
fix: Implemented Command.readFromIntent(intent, fallback) only for absent extras; VpnService.readServiceCommand uses START fallback for SERVICE_INTERFACE and null sticky restart, UNKNOWN otherwise. Existing receiver default, permission manifest, worker/revoke guards and explicit STOP preserved.
test_evidence: Six command decode regressions passed in full batch-three. Opt-in API34 framework start with real prepared consent passed; foreground tunnel established, stopped and resumed. Four total live lifecycle/DNS cases passed. Actual Settings always-on toggle/reboot and other Android versions remain separate gaps.

title: In-flight lookup republishes stale rule after cache invalidation
reproduction: REGRESSIONS ADDED, NOT RUN: inFlightAllowedLookupCannotRepopulateCacheAfterBlocking and inFlightBlockedLookupCannotRepopulateCacheAfterAllowing pause after actual Room DAO old result, mutate/sync rules, complete invalidation, then release and join old lookup before the first fresh getEntry. Restore evictAll behavior to demonstrate red/green in main's build.
expected: Old in-flight request may finish with its captured rule, but cannot publish into active cache; lookups begun after completed invalidation use fresh rules and then cache them. Invalidation does not wait for old database I/O.
observed: BASELINE SOURCE-CONFIRMED: evictAll could be followed by stale create insertion. IMPLEMENTATION SOURCE-REVIEWED ONLY: volatile publication replaces entire LruCache and each lookup retains one cache reference, isolating old publication. Runtime race tests remain unexecuted.
fix: Implemented volatile LruCache replacement on invalidation and local cache snapshot in getEntry. Added package-private HostEntryDao constructor for tests without altering production DAO selection. No database/source/UI changes.
test_evidence: Batch-one API34: both new latch-controlled Room-backed stale-cache races and both existing sequential invalidation regressions passed. Old in-flight result may finish; active cache remains current on subsequent lookup.

title: Losing one network clears every network of its transport
reproduction: SOURCE CONFIRMED; REGRESSIONS ADDED NOT RUN HERE: WiFi A/B overlap; loss A retains B; duplicates/unknown loss; final loss; late callbacks after stop.
expected: Keep protection while another usable Network remains; wait only after final usable upstream loss.
observed: Baseline identity-free transport set reconfirmed. Source-reviewed implementation now tracks each Network and requires callback DNS/capability readiness. Main reported production compile pass; no runtime closure claimed.
fix: Added service-owned VpnNetworkMonitor, guarded 100ms coalescing, callback readiness on start, close/unregister on destruction, and stop cancellation. Existing current-worker and service command paths preserved.
test_evidence: API34 monitor14 and actual service-handler3 cases passed after public getter/snapshot fixture correction. No hidden API or SDK suppression. Synthetic overlap/final-loss proof, not physical WiFi/cellular handoff.

expected: Refresh selected Network/DNS coherently and send protected resolver traffic on that Network; preserve stop guards and avoid duplicate rebuilds.

fix: Callback-driven snapshot rebuild; protected bound connected sockets in both forwarding overloads; bound watchdog; failed binding closes without default fallback. No heuristic claims exact pre31 same-transport default identity.

title: Known-provider IPv6 routes are gated by upstream DNS address family
reproduction: REGRESSIONS ADDED NOT RUN HERE: full resolver-family/preference builder matrix. Main reported earlier 12:08 mapper-only APK onboarding with IPv4 DNS and all eight provider IPv6 host routes on actual tun0.
expected: Provider IPv6 host routes apply independently of advertised resolver family; ordinary IPv6 keeps baseline routing and IPv6-only DNS remains usable.
observed: Source confirmed old gating. New configure installs both provider families. VpnBuilder already always allows AF_INET6 even with preference false; no newly removed implicit family block. Main route-installation report is not live IPv6 reachability or fallback proof.
fix: Always include both provider route families; preserve preference-based mixed-family alias filtering and IPv6-only fallback. No IPv6 default route or extra IPv6 alias/interface added for IPv4 DNS.
test_evidence: All10 API34 mapper cases passed across resolver/preference combinations. Earlier mapper-only APK installed all8 provider IPv6 routes with IPv4 upstream; no live IPv6 reachability or browser fallback claim.

title: DNS runtime test cleanup deletes unrelated real-domain user rules
reproduction: PROPOSED, NOT RUN; disposable database only: Seed a USER redirect/block/allow for www.ynet.co.il, run an unrelated exact-block test in DnsPacketProxyRuntimeTruthTest, then compare original rows and IDs.
expected: Test setup/teardown preserves all pre-existing non-fixture user rules, including real-domain compatibility entries.
